articles.original_title: Biographical notes

articles.original_title: Biographical notes
articles.original_summary: Angad Singh Dhillon most recently served as Director of Operations and Stakeholder Relations in the Office of the Prime Minister of Canada. As one of Prime Minister Mark Carney’s closest advisers, he supported the Prime Minister in re-engaging Canada’s diplomatic relationships with key bilateral partners, including India and China, by helping restore high-level channels of communication and cooperation. He also led stakeholder coordination to secure incoming investment commitments into Canada, including the development and planning of Canada’s inaugural national Investment Summit. He also previously served as Chief of Staff to two federal Cabinet ministers in the small business and transport portfolios. In these roles, he supported Canada’s engagements at the G7, G20, UN General Assembly, Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, International Transport Forum and Conference of the Parties.

articles.original_title: Biographical notes
articles.original_summary: Angad Singh Dhillon most recently served as Director of Operations and Stakeholder Relations in the Office of the Prime Minister of Canada. As one of Prime Minister Mark Carney’s closest advisers, he supported the Prime Minister in re-engaging Canada’s diplomatic relationships with key bilateral partners, including India and China, by helping restore high-level channels of communication and cooperation. He also led stakeholder coordination to secure incoming investment commitments into Canada, including the development and planning of Canada’s inaugural national Investment Summit. He also previously served as Chief of Staff to two federal Cabinet ministers in the small business and transport portfolios. In these roles, he supported Canada’s engagements at the G7, G20, UN General Assembly, Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, International Transport Forum and Conference of the Parties.
